info.title: OMA LwM2M LPWAN Mesh Statistics (Object ID 3448)

LPWAN_Mesh_Statistics.label: LPWAN Mesh Statistics
LPWAN_Mesh_Statistics.description: The uCIFI LPWAN Mesh Statistics object enables the client to collect statistical information specifically tailored to monitor performance of 805.15.4 mesh networks. The object encompasses resources that provide visibility over both MAC layer and Network Layer statistics, the applicability of which is dependent on the specific 802.15.4 technology.

Tx_Packets_Total.label: Tx Packets Total
Tx_Packets_Total.description: IEEE 802.15.4 macTxSuccessCount, Packets transmitted and acked with no retries.

Tx_Success_on_single_Retry.label: Tx Success on single Retry
Tx_Success_on_single_Retry.description: IEEE 802.15.4 macRetryCount, successful transmission after one retry.

Tx_Success_on_Multi_Retry.label: Tx Success on Multi Retry
Tx_Success_on_Multi_Retry.description: IEEE 802.15.4 macMultipleRetryCount, TX acked after more than one retry.

Tx_Discarded_packets.label: Tx Discarded packets
Tx_Discarded_packets.description: Total number of packets that failed transmission.

TX_CCA_failures.label: TX CCA failures
TX_CCA_failures.description: Total number of packets that failed to transmit due to busy channel.

Tx_ACK_failure.label: Tx ACK failure
Tx_ACK_failure.description: Total number of packets that failed to transmit due to lack of acknowledgement.

Rx_Malformed_Packets.label: Rx Malformed Packets
Rx_Malformed_Packets.description: Total number of packets that failed to parse due to inconsistencies on frame headers.

Rx_Unsecure_Packets.label: Rx Unsecure Packets
Rx_Unsecure_Packets.description: Total packets discarded due to inconsistencies on security information (802.15.4 macSecurityFailure).

Rx_duplicate_Packets.label: Rx duplicate Packets
Rx_duplicate_Packets.description: Total number of duplicate packets droped (802.15.4 macDuplicateFrameCount).

Beacon_Frames_Sent.label: Beacon Frames Sent
Beacon_Frames_Sent.description: Used as a cumulative counter to report on the number of IEEE 802.15.4 Beacons frames transmitted by the device. These are used for mesh network management operations (advertising, discovery, etc.).

Beacon_Frames_Received.label: Beacon Frames Received
Beacon_Frames_Received.description: Used as a cumulative counter to report on the number of IEEE 802.15.4 Beacons frames received by the device. These are used for mesh network management operations (advertising, discovery, etc.).

Ack_Frames_Sent.label: Ack Frames Sent
Ack_Frames_Sent.description: Used as a cumulative counter to report on the number of IEEE 802.15.4 Acknowledgment frames transmitted by the device.

Ack_Frames_Received.label: Ack Frames Received
Ack_Frames_Received.description: Used as a cumulative counter to report on the number of IEEE 802.15.4 Acknowledgment frames received by the device.

Command_Frames_Sent.label: Command Frames Sent
Command_Frames_Sent.description: Used as a cumulative counter to report on the number of IEEE 802.15.4 Command frames transmitted by the device. These maybe used for mesh network management operations (association, disassociation, beacon request, etc.).

Command_Frames_Received.label: Command Frames Received
Command_Frames_Received.description: Used as a cumulative counter to report on the number of IEEE 802.15.4 Command frames received by the device. These maybe used for mesh network management operations (association, disassociation, beacon request, etc.).

Data_Frames_Sent.label: Data Frames Sent
Data_Frames_Sent.description: Used as a cumulative counter to report on the number of IEEE 802.15.4 Data frames transmitted by the device.

Data_Frames_Received.label: Data Frames Received
Data_Frames_Received.description: Used as a cumulative counter to report on the number of IEEE 802.15.4 Data frames received by the device.

Data_Bytes_Sent.label: Data Bytes Sent
Data_Bytes_Sent.description: Total number of payload data bytes sent via this interface.

Data_Bytes_Received.label: Data Bytes Received
Data_Bytes_Received.description: Total number of payload data bytes received via this interface.

Timestamp.label: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: The timestamp of when the measurement was performed.

Fractional_Timestamp.label: Fractional Timestamp
Fractional_Timestamp.description: Fractional part of the timestamp when sub-second precision is used (e.g., 0.23 for 230 ms).

Measurement_Quality_Indicator.label: Measurement Quality Indicator
Measurement_Quality_Indicator.description: Measurement quality indicator reported by a smart sensor. 0: UNCHECKED No quality checks were done because they do not exist or can not be applied. 1: REJECTED WITH CERTAINTY The measured value is invalid. 2: REJECTED WITH PROBABILITY The measured value is likely invalid. 3: ACCEPTED BUT SUSPICIOUS The measured value is likely OK. 4: ACCEPTED The measured value is OK. 5-15: Reserved for future extensions. 16-23: Vendor specific measurement quality.

Measurement_Quality_Level.label: Measurement Quality Level
Measurement_Quality_Level.description: Measurement quality level reported by a smart sensor. Quality level 100 means that the measurement has fully passed quality check algorithms. Smaller quality levels mean that quality has decreased and the measurement has only partially passed quality check algorithms. The smaller the quality level, the more caution should be used by the application when using the measurement. When the quality level is 0 it means that the measurement should certainly be rejected.

Start.label: Start
Start.description: Reset all resources and start collection period.

Stop.label: Stop
Stop.description: Stop collecting information, but do not reset resources.
